name: Apollo
title: Light of Olympus
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: A deity of broad influence—light and the sun, art and poetry, song and prophecy, archery and disease—Apollo has become a vital element of Olympus’s diplomatic efforts. He is considered most likely to find common ground with, or at least charm, neighboring pantheons, while also being able to spot danger in advance and to defend himself if negotiations go sour.
